app.title: Moat: Your OpenRouter Replacement
app.description: A lightweight, self-hosted alternative to OpenRouter for routing requests to multiple LLM providers.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `docker compose up -d` to start the service
Send a POST request to /v1/chat/completions and verify response format
Measure latency of a simple completion request
Run the CLI tool to list available providers and compare with OpenRouter API
